answer: Admission now asks the bank. At join the node sends 37 cents in two deposits to the declared account, each memo carrying a six digit code. Reporting both proves a return path into that account, and the registry hashes the account token, so one account holds one seat however many keys ask. A border guard once looked at a passport holder, and a bank once confirmed a body sits on that account. Verified accounts trade near 40 dollars, settlement runs two days, so a fifty seat orchard costs 2,000 dollars before one whisper of income, and a voyage across three countries triggers a freeze.
